task_name: Implement supplier performance BI with coverage

concerns_addressed: Fulfillment 50%, on-time 30%, catalog 20% weights and exact component ratios verified (0.7500/0.6667/0.8000, weighted 0.7350).
Denominator eligibility excludes Cancelled/Canceled/Rejected/Invalid; missing delivery/due_date excluded only from on-time denominator with coverage reported.
Stage publishes named supplier section; admin consumer reads via ActiveDataSnapshotReader with snapshot_version/window metadata and no live recompute.
No-observation suppliers return insufficient-data with null scores; no fabricated score.
Supplier BI route is admin-only with existing 401/403 contract; on-time schema migration is in-scope infrastructure.

strengths: Decimal-safe explicit ratio calculations and centralized insufficient-data handling.
Single named overlap-free read seam and thin controller boundary.

issues.description: Unused Delivery and Order imports in SupplierPerformanceService.
Stale variable name catalogByShop should be catalogBySupplier.
Orphaned @param Supplier docblock disconnected from its method.
